summary: Valenzuela 2nd District representative with 155 principal-authored bills. Authored repeal of the estate tax, a cut in the PhilHealth premium to 3 percent, suspension of oil taxes during price spikes, other National Internal Revenue Code amendments and a SIM Registration Act amendment.
caveat: Only five rubric bills surfaced from 155. SIM registration amendment direction unreviewed, so civil liberties is not scored.

economic.label: Center-right
economic.rationale: Authored estate tax repeal (+3) and oil tax suspension (+1) as one taxes issue, and a PhilHealth premium cut to 3 percent (+2), lowering social-insurance funding. Two issues only.
